description: Data underlying the master thesis: Modelling and Assessment of an Autonomous Ride-Sharing Service’s Urban Utilization provides Rotterdam road-network inputs, Python code, SUMO simulation runs and spreadsheet outputs for autonomous ride sharing. The provider is Mahtab Sharifi. Geographical and temporal coverage: The 2022 deposit supports an MSc thesis comparing traffic and carbon-emission scenarios in Rotterdam. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The archive combines model inputs and results. No scenario was executed and thesis findings are not operational evidence. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
